description: React component for a modal overlay that displays detailed cost information and raw JSON data for a user, including fetching user info, handling state, and rendering project and agent details.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user name based on userId when modal opens or userId changes.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various input formats (string, number) to a finite number, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using a fallback method if navigator.clipboard is unavailable.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles copying the JSON data to clipboard and updates copy status.
